inventoryPolicy.authority: Existing Zod configuration sources listed per item.
inventoryPolicy.coverage: Every uppercase property in the first z.object configuration schema of each source.
inventoryPolicy.defaultSemantics: defaultDefined=false means no silent default; defaultValue is null only as a placeholder in that case.
inventoryPolicy.applyMode: Current processes parse these values at startup. Identity/version are immutable; every other not-yet-reviewed field is conservatively restart_required pending P3 extraction.
inventoryPolicy.secretSemantics: Secret values and secret-bearing file references are identified separately. Secret source literals are redacted and hash-locked; the inventory contains no secret value.

bootstrap.description: Cold-start Runtime identity, listener, database, Adapter, and authentication inputs.

runtime.description: Runtime workers, limits, telemetry, events, notifications, and outbox inputs.

provider.description: UGV, NPC Tank, and Home Assistant Adapter inputs.

collector.description: No Collector configuration source exists in the delivered repository; no fields are invented.
